family_title_en: Capitalizing the names of places and geographic features

stages.ix_title: Capitalizing the names of places and geographic features

what_to_do.en: Tap the sentence that uses capitals the right way.

stages.choice_rule: Four full sentences that reuse the stem words. Exactly one capitalizes the first word plus place and geographic names only (cities, states, countries, and named streets, lakes, and rivers). Two-word names need a capital on each word. Distractors leave a place name lowercase, capitalize only one word of a two-word name, capitalize a common place word (park, lake, river, beach, school, street), or capitalize a random mid-sentence word. Never change word order or add words.

gold_items.stem: The bus stop is on main street.
choices: The bus stop is on Main Street.
The bus stop is on main street.
The bus stop is on Main street.
The Bus stop is on main Street.

gold_items.stem: My aunt is in new york.
choices: My aunt is in New York.
My aunt is in new york.
My aunt is in New york.
My Aunt is in new York.

gold_items.stem: The beach in florida is hot.
choices: The beach in Florida is hot.
The Beach in florida is hot.
The beach in florida is hot.
The Beach in Florida is hot.

roots: Keep all four choices the same words in the same order. Only capitals may change.
Exactly one choice is right: first word plus place and geographic names only.
Wrong choices must be near the skill: drop the place capital, cap a common place word, cap only half of a two-word name, or cap a random verb or noun.
Never use real personal names. Use <NAME> when a person is needed.
Keep stems in kid world: home, school, family, pets, play, food, weather. No brands.
Balance the pool across cities, states, countries, named streets or rivers, common place words, and mixed stems that hold both.

tier_rules.1: Short stems of four to six words. One clear city, state, or country left lowercase, or one common place word wrongly capitalized. Distractors are far: a random mid-sentence capital or a lowercase first word.
tier_rules.2: Grade-level stems of five to eight words. Use two-syllable place names and named streets. Distractors miss one word of a two-word name or capitalize school, park, or street when it is not a name.
tier_rules.3: Near misses. Mix a common place word with a real place name, or use two-word places. Distractors capitalize the common word, leave one half of the name lowercase, or capitalize a verb.

place_name.en: Names of cities, states, and countries need a capital letter.
place_name.ko: 도시, 주, 나라 이름은 대문자로 씁니다.

geo_name.en: Names of streets, lakes, and rivers need a capital.
geo_name.ko: 거리, 호수, 강 이름은 대문자로 씁니다.

common_place.en: A regular park, lake, or river is not a name. Do not capitalize it.
common_place.ko: 그냥 공원, 호수, 강은 이름이 아닙니다. 대문자로 쓰지 마세요.

place_not_common.en: Capitalize the place name. Leave park, beach, and river lowercase.
place_not_common.ko: 지명만 대문자로 쓰고, 공원, 해변, 강은 소문자로 두세요.

first_only.en: Capitalize the place name. Do not capitalize every word.
first_only.ko: 지명만 대문자로 쓰세요. 모든 단어를 대문자로 쓰지 마세요.
